title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan SAMPADA Yojana (PMKSY):
summary: Schemes — Pradhan Mantri Kisan SAMPADA Yojana (PMKSY):

items:  Launched in 2016 by the Ministry of Food Processing Industries, aims to enhance food
processing, reduce post-harvest losses, and improve supply chains.
 Key Objectives:
o Increase agricultural value addition.
o Promote agro-based industries.
o Improve market access and employment.
o Reduce post-harvest wastage.
 Key Components:
 Mega Food Parks: Infrastructure for processing.
 Cold Chain & Value Addition: Reduce waste, enhance quality.
 Backward & Forward Linkages: Connect farmers with processing.
 Agro Processing Clusters: Localized units.
 Food Safety Infrastructure: Ensure quality standards
 Skill Development: Enhance workforce capabilities.
 Budget:
o Rs. 6000 crore (2016-2020), Rs. 4600 crore till 2026.
 Benefits:
o Boosts rural economy and farmer incomes.
o Creates jobs, reduces food waste, and improves quality.
PMKSY transforms India’s food processing sector and uplifts farmers' livelihoods.
